'''Winged lizards''' were flying [[Bat/Legends|bat]]-like [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavian]] creatures that could be found in the [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="GB Manual>''[[Super Star Wars: Return of the Jedi]]'' Game Boy manual</ref> The dangerous flying creatures had [[Color/Legends|green]] and yellow skin, as well as red eyes and a red beak. It could swoop down and attack prey with its talons.<ref name="SROTJ" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Super Star Wars: Return of the Jedi]]'' {{1st}}
